== Summary ==
Identified: [[Nathan Davis]] (blue Seattle cap and a Seahawks hoodie; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]], where the cap is on a Mariners jersey), [[Jack Douglass]] (hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same shirt as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), [[Brandon Baity]] (green plaid shirt and a beard), [[Jacy Smith]] (heavy-set, dark grey shirt, seen from behind), [[Nathan Russell]] (balding, navy tee and glasses), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (standing, grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard; same person as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]] and the JUSTIN M / joyjoy Advocate Award card in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026. Remaining: the seated player in a grey cap and a black tee, seen from behind, and a standing player in the back room.


Players at the 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2026-04-11
* '''Camera date:''' 2025-06-21
* '''Identification:''' [[Nathan Davis]] (blue Seattle cap and a Seahawks hoodie; same face and cap as [[:File:Nathan Davis 2025 World Championship.jpg]], where the cap is on a Mariners jersey), [[Jack Douglass]] (hair in a bun, glasses, a beard, and a black sunset-graphic tee; same shirt as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), [[Brandon Baity]] (green plaid shirt and a beard), [[Jacy Smith]] (heavy-set, dark grey shirt, seen from behind), [[Nathan Russell]] (balding, navy tee and glasses), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (standing, grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard; same person as [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 3.jpg]] and the JUSTIN M / joyjoy Advocate Award card in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026. Remaining: the seated player in a grey cap and a black tee, seen from behind, and a standing player in the back room.
